title: Inspect and report an interrupted change with one observed effect

items.request.inspect-interrupted: The caller asks what happened after an interrupted multi-effect change
items.lookup.operation-effects: A request for the journal and every affected reference
items.store.journal.interrupted: The durable operation journal records an interruption
items.store.effect.observation-applied: Inspection establishes that the observation effect applied
items.status.correction-indeterminate: The correction effect cannot yet be established
items.status.link-not-applied: Inspection establishes that the link did not apply
items.coverage.effects-inspected: Every named effect was inspected even though one remains unknown
items.response.partial-and-indeterminate: The caller receives each applied, absent, and unknown effect separately
items.durable.replayed-observation: A duplicate observation created during inspection

steps.note: Send the interrupted operation identity and ask for its effects
Ask for the durable journal and each named effect
Return one applied effect, one absent effect, one unknown effect, and inspection coverage
Report every effect separately and preserve the unknown correction status
